caption:
Massage before a race or after it? Timing matters more than you'd think 🏃

Race week isn't the time to try deep tissue work for the first time. If you like a pre-event massage, book it two to four days out with lighter pressure. Deep work too close to the start can leave you feeling flat.

Afterwards, rest, rehydrate, eat and walk it out first. A gentle massage a day or two later can ease stiffness. Research suggests massage can reduce how sore you feel, but it complements sleep, food and easy movement rather than replacing them.

Plan your timing with our remedial massage therapists at Hybrid Physio. Book online via the link in bio.
